import json, os, time, urllib.request, urllib.error
auth=os.environ['GW_TOKEN'].strip()
if auth.startswith('{'):
    p=json.loads(auth); auth=next((p[k] for k in ('api_key','key','value') if p.get(k)),auth)
if not auth.lower().startswith('bearer'): auth='Bearer '+auth
pid=os.environ['HARNESS_PATIENT_ID']; store=os.environ['HARNESS_STORE']
def call(path,body):
    req=urllib.request.Request('https://mott-booking-gw.mail.mybcat.com'+path,data=json.dumps(body).encode(),method='POST',headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','Authorization':auth})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=60) as r: return r.status,json.loads(r.read().decode())
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: return e.code,{'err':e.read().decode(errors='replace')[:200]}
st,av=call('/availability',{'store':store,'from':'08/06/2026','to':'08/06/2026','after':'none','before':'none','time_pref':'none','slot_minutes':'15','callID':'bookdiag','user_text':'08/06/2026','user_verbatim':'08/06/2026'})
res=av.get('result') or {}
slot=(res.get('slots') or [{}])[0]
print('STEP1_SLOT=%s doctor=%s end=%s' % (slot.get('start'), slot.get('doctor'), slot.get('end')))
stb,bk=call('/sign',{'verb':'appt.book','target':pid,'store':store,'reason':'new-booking','params':{'doctor':slot.get('doctor') or res.get('first_doctor'),'start':slot.get('start') or res.get('first_start'),'end':slot.get('end') or res.get('first_end'),'type':'674597395'}})
print('STEP2_BOOK_STATUS=%s BODY=%s' % (stb, json.dumps(bk)[:400]))
time.sleep(4)
sta,lst=call('/appt-list',{'patient_id':pid,'store':store})
lr=lst.get('result') or {}
print('STEP3_APPT_COUNT=%s APPTS=%s' % (lr.get('count'), [(a.get('appointment_id'),a.get('start')) for a in (lr.get('appointments') or [])]))
for a in (lr.get('appointments') or []):
    call('/sign',{'verb':'appt.cancel','target':a.get('appointment_id'),'store':store,'reason':'patient-request','params':{'appt_id':a.get('appointment_id'),'day':(a.get('start') or '')[:10]}})
time.sleep(3)
stc,fin=call('/appt-list',{'patient_id':pid,'store':store})
print('STEP4_CLEANUP_COUNT=%s' % ((fin.get('result') or {}).get('count')))
print('DIAG_DONE')
PY
